stemMd: The two roots of x squared minus 7x plus 10 = 0 are used as the sides of a rectangle. What is its area?
explanationMd: Factor the quadratic as (x−2)(x−5). The side lengths are 2 and 5, so area is 10. The constant term also gives the root product directly.

distractorRationale.e: This squares only the larger root.
distractorRationale.d: This is the sum of the roots, not their product.
distractorRationale.a: This squares only the smaller root.
distractorRationale.c: This is the perimeter of the rectangle.
